verdict.rationale: The docs say `opencode serve` runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint, and a type-safe JS/TS SDK is built on that server. An independent probe confirmed https://opencode.ai/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key, so the spec can be downloaded. missing for 10: documentation of spec coverage/versioning and how the hosted spec relates to the local server's endpoint.
